data.title: Eric Trump Likens Bitcoin's Latest Spike Above $81,000 as 'Almost Like a Flight to Security' After Democrats Take Congress
data.description: American Bitcoin Corp. co-founder Eric Trump said on Wednesday that Bitcoin’s latest spike reflected the new reality of a “split government” after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Midterm Results a Bullish Catalyst for BTC? Bitcoin rose sharply from $77,000...
